pages.title: Reactor Wrench
pages.text: The tool for working on a multiblock without taking it apart.$(br2)Right click a block to cycle its setting where it has one, such as flipping an Access Port or Coolant Port between Inlet and Outlet.

pages.title: Debugging
pages.text: Sneak and right click a multiblock block with the wrench to dump its internal state into chat: which controller owns it, the bounds of the multiblock, the block count and the last validation error.$(br2)That is usually faster than guessing why a structure refuses to assemble.
